selected_priority: Compose estate recovery census priority directly into exact-source federated restoration packet build/apply execution.
displaced_capability: Estate recovery census could rank repository-level recovery need, while federated restoration could import and compose an exact donor revision, but no executable bridge turned the ranked estate observation into a SHA-bound restoration packet.

mechanisms_compared.assessment: Manually feed census output into existing federated restoration calls. Preserves mechanisms but leaves the critical selection-to-execution bridge manual.
Replace both engines with a new unified recovery service. Rejected because it would duplicate strong exact-source and census mechanisms and increase regression risk.
Selected: preserve both proven engines and add deterministic estate qualification, target selection, exact packet construction, optional application, CLI execution, and fail-closed behavior.

capabilities: qualify repository recovery candidates from live estate census state
reject missing, inaccessible, archived, disabled, and healthy repositories from automatic packet selection
rank surviving executable restoration targets deterministically by census priority
bind the selected target to an exact federated donor source/ref and semantic symbol closure
build SHA-bound federated restoration packets using the existing exact-source import and cross-file semantic engine
optionally apply the selected restoration packet through the existing drift-guarded federated applier
emit structured execution results for downstream recovery automation

preserved_gains: estate census remains read-only and does not mutate donor repositories
federated donor import remains exact-source and credentials-safe
cross-file semantic restoration drift guards remain intact
missing or inaccessible repositories are not promoted into deletion claims
historical donor code is not blindly reverted wholesale
existing restoration engines remain independently usable

checks: strict Ruff over executable orchestration and adversarial tests
fail-closed filtering for missing and healthy targets
ranked target binding into packet builder
